Subject: RFP: freewnn -- network-extensible Japanese/Chinese/Korean input system

Package: wnpp
Severity: wishlist

This file is a draft only. It must not be submitted without adopter review.

FreeWnn is a network-extensible input system supporting Japanese, Simplified
and Traditional Chinese, and Korean. A technical Debian unstable candidate
based on upstream 1.1.1-a023 exists, with current-compiler portability fixes,
the previous Debian binary package split and t64 transition names, sid CI,
and an installed-library compile, link, and run smoke check.

An adopter is still needed. Maintainer selection, copyright and policy review,
and the init/systemd policy for the server packages are explicit upload
blockers. The candidate is not an upload and its repository owner is not
volunteering to maintain or upload the Debian package. The owner may assist
with upstream C portability and Mule compatibility.
